title: XFastest — warm minimal SaaS explainer for an X growth tool
summary: A 30 s silent-VO SaaS explainer on a warm beige canvas with soft peach light. Each feature is a two-beat pair: a centred two-line statement ('Find creators in your niche.', 'See what's working for them.', 'Make it yours.', 'Score it before you post.', 'Learn what actually moves views.') with a rust-coloured full stop, then the rebuilt UI doing it up close, cursor-driven (niche chips selected, Discover creators clicked, progress bar, creator list; a flat line spiking to 12.4x; a draft rewritten; a score card 92 / Ship; a posting calendar). One green guarantee beat: '500 followers in 30 days or get a full refund.' over a rising chart. Ends on the X logo mark assembling into 'XFastest'. Calm, warm, very readable.
fit_reason: Statement → close-up UI proof rhythm, warm-neutral palette with one brand accent, cursor-driven rebuilt UI and a guarantee beat in a contrasting colour: a near-direct blueprint for SaaSSuite feature explainers in Andrew's plain 'show the screen' voice.
